worldcombat.skill.endure.summary: Inside a short window, an enemy's lethal blow only brings you down to 1 HP; it does not reduce ordinary damage, and repeated use tends to fail outright.
worldcombat.skill.endure.description.0: An endure window of %1$s ticks (longer with higher Sp. Def and level), up to %2$s saves: inside it only a lethal blow from an enemy is caught, cutting it down to leave just %3$s HP; ordinary damage is taken as normal and spends no save, and it ends when the saves run out or the window elapses.
worldcombat.skill.endure.description.1: After a %1$s-tick brace the window opens, on a full cooldown of %2$s; once every save is spent you are exhausted for %3$s ticks.
worldcombat.skill.endure.description.2: Repeat-use failure chance %1$s: the first use always succeeds, then each further use within 12 seconds raises it a step (about +25%% each) and is rolled to fail outright without opening the window; the count resets after 12 seconds without use.
worldcombat.skill.endure.use.0: Hang on at low health and wait for rescue
worldcombat.skill.endure.use.1: Buy an ally an interrupt or a retreat
worldcombat.skill.endure.preference.scra: On (scramble): window x0.75 but free to move, recover 12 ticks, no exhaustion. Off (stand-off): window x1.25, rooted throughout, 30 ticks of exhaustion after the saves are spent, recover 6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.endure.preference.ai.t: Only brace below this health ratio. Larger is more cautious and spends PP earlier; smaller saves PP but may be too late.
worldcombat.skill.endure.posture: Posture: with Scramble on the window is x0.75, you move freely throughout, there is no exhaustion and recovery is 12 ticks; with it off (Stand-off) the window is x1.25, you cannot move at all (but can still act), and spending the saves leaves you rooted in exhaustion, with a 6-tick recovery.
